title: One-Step Recurrence for the Run Value
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $K,i,c$ be nonnegative integers. The run value for $i+1$ blocks, starting with count $c$, equals $p$ times the run value for $i$ blocks starting with count $c+1$, plus $(1-p)$ times the run value for $i$ blocks starting with count $c$, where $p$ is the probability that $N$ accepts on a uniformly random choice word of length $K$ when run on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
